assessment.nobel_worthiness: The magic-wavelength idea makes many trapped atoms an unusually clean clock and opens precise tests of gravity and atomic interactions. Its basic measurement principle is Nobel-worthy.
assessment.attribution: Katori's conception and Ye's precision realization provide a focused configuration.
assessment.maturity: The method has an established record of independent development and precision use.
uncertainties: The entry gives no error budgets or priority documentation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Preparing and controlling mechanical motion in its quantum regime reveals where familiar classical motion ceases to suffice. This addresses a fundamental question I value highly.
assessment.attribution: The three credited researchers represent complementary mechanical and radiation-pressure control programs.
assessment.maturity: Ground-state control and quantum readout form an established experimental body of work.
uncertainties: Distinguish cooling, detection and coherent quantum control, and confirm how each decisive contribution fits a common citation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: An atomic realization of the Hubbard model makes strongly interacting quantum behavior calculable and observable under controlled conditions.
assessment.attribution: Zoller represents the theoretical realization; Bloch and Greiner the Mott-transition experiments and microscopy.
assessment.maturity: Optical-lattice simulation is mature and has been reproduced and extended broadly.
uncertainties: Cirac also has foundational credit; a three-person limit requires careful attribution rather than an assumed hierarchy.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Phase shifts tied to potentials and geometry expose a deep feature of the quantum wavefunction with direct interferometric consequences.
assessment.attribution: The two names correspond to the two foundational phenomena named in the entry.
assessment.maturity: The underlying phenomena are well established across quantum physics.
uncertainties: These are distinct discoveries; their shared geometric meaning must justify a joint citation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Matter-wave interference provides a conceptually transparent and quantitatively demanding test of coherence, recoil and forces.
assessment.attribution: The three names span the major photon-recoil, grating and light-pulse approaches.
assessment.maturity: The core methods have a long record of independent experimental use.
uncertainties: I would review the chronology and relative contributions to avoid treating all later precision advances as one discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Direct molecular laser cooling overcomes the internal complexity that makes molecules fundamentally different from atoms, opening a new regime of quantum control.
assessment.attribution: The supplied names cover complementary demonstrations and methods for molecular laser cooling and trapping.
assessment.maturity: The central cooling and trapping achievement is established; future molecular computation is not needed to justify it.
uncertainties: The packet alone cannot settle first-demonstration and enabling-method credit among the three.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A sharply stated theoretical classification and an observable protected-edge realization are a compelling new understanding of quantum matter.
assessment.attribution: I provisionally focus on the Kane-Mele theory and Molenkamp's quantum spin Hall experiment.
assessment.maturity: The time-reversal-invariant topological-insulator phenomenon is established.
uncertainties: Hasan is also credited, presumably reflecting three-dimensional realization; a narrower citation and attribution review are needed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantum disturbance and entanglement become principles for secure information rather than only interpretive puzzles. The foundational conceptual advance merits recognition.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Brassard provide the key-distribution protocol; Ekert supplies its entanglement-based formulation.
assessment.maturity: Quantum key distribution has an extensive theoretical and experimental record.
uncertainties: Ideal physical security must be distinguished from implementation imperfections; the original attribution is clearer than every later network advance.
